bio: After honing her skills in top restaurants (including La Vague d’Or), chef Anne-Sophie Sabini has struck out on her own in this modern, colourful gastropub, flanked by a lovely terrace. She has devised a concise menu that changes monthly, in which she adds a feminine, modern touch to Gallic standards: cream of green peas with a 64° poached egg, coppa, crunchy croutons and organic olive oil from Provence; roast squid and black pudding, purée of carrots, citrus-flavoured dressing; sorbet of Beaulieu mandarin, anis-flavoured biscuit, praline and drizzled citrus fruit and bergamot … Slick service, charming welcome. Heaven for foodies!...
